lines.en: label beachvacation6:
scene yumisits1
: She’s been sitting there for like an hour.
lines.zh: : 她在那儿坐了大概一个小时了吧。

lines.en: : Yeah...I feel kind of bad.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我有点过意不去。

lines.en: scene yumisits2
: Dude. You’re too nice.
lines.zh: : 姐妹。你太善良了。

lines.en: : Isn’t she a bitch to you like, literally every day ever? You shouldn’t feel bad just because she’s alone.
lines.zh: : 她不是每天都对你很凶吗？你没必要就因为她一个人坐着就心软。

lines.en: scene yumisits3
: I know...but imagine if that were me or you.
lines.zh: : 我知道……可你想想，要是我或者你呢。

lines.en: : It probably took a lot of courage for her to even come here today. Especially since Chika isn’t here.
lines.zh: : 她今天能来，大概也鼓起了很大的勇气。更何况Chika不在。

lines.en: scene yumisits4
: Oh! Is Chika not here? I didn’t even notice. Hahahah!
lines.zh: : 哦！Chika没来吗？我都没注意。哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : That’s the same exact response you’ve had to that every single time it’s been brought up today.
lines.zh: : 今天每次提到这个，你都是一模一样的反应。

lines.en: : I mean, how weird would it be if I were to just...keep tabs on where Chika is at all times, right? Hahahah.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我要是……时时刻刻盯着Chika在哪儿，那也太奇怪了吧？哈哈哈哈。

lines.en: : That would be like, totally stalkerish. Who even is Chika? I’ve never heard that name before.
lines.zh: : 那简直就是跟踪狂。Chika是谁？我从没听过这名字。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 是哦……

lines.en: scene yumisits5
: Well, uhh, anyway! Why don’t we get back to talking about that girl over there? The one with the surprisingly hot body that I’m totally not jealous of.
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯，总之！我们还是继续聊那边那个女生吧？身材意外地火辣，我绝对没有嫉妒。

lines.en: : Her name is Yumi...You know that...
lines.zh: : 她叫Yumi……你知道的……

lines.en: : Yeah, that girl. What do you wanna do?
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个女生。你想怎么办？

lines.en: scene yumisits6
: What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean, this is all on you. I’m just here for moral support.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，这全看你。我只是来给你打气的。

lines.en: : I thought you were gonna have one of those breakthrough things and approach her.
lines.zh: : 我以为你会来个什么突破，主动去跟她搭话。

lines.en: : That’s what it seemed like you were leading up to at least.
lines.zh: : 至少你之前铺垫得像是这个意思。

lines.en: scene yumisits7
: Approach her and do what? The second I go over there she’ll just make some joke about...whales or something again...
lines.zh: : 搭话然后干什么？我一过去，她又会开什么……鲸鱼之类的玩笑……

lines.en: : Then fuckin’...kick some sand in her face and call her a loser or something. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 那就……往她脸上踢沙子，骂她是个废物之类的。我也不知道。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound like moral support, Rin...
lines.zh: : 这听起来可不像是给我打气啊，Rin……

lines.en: scene yumisits8
: Well...then how about this? {i}Both{/i} of us will go over there and try talking to her normally. Like she’s any other girl in class.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那这样怎么样？{i}我们两个{/i}一起过去，试着正常地跟她说话。就当她是班上任何一个普通女生。

lines.en: : That has never worked before and I can’t imagine it working right now. But it’s a nice idea.
lines.zh: : 这招从来没奏效过，我也想象不出这次能行。不过想法是好的。

lines.en: scene yumisits9
: Ugh, this is so stupid. Why does she have a problem with {i}you{/i} of all people?
lines.zh: : 啧，真是蠢死了。她干嘛偏偏要找{i}你{/i}的麻烦？

lines.en: : You’re like the sweetest and nicest and cutest and smartest girl I know. And you’re always looking out for everybody.
lines.zh: : 你是我认识的最温柔最善良最可爱最聪明的女孩。而且你总是照顾所有人。

lines.en: : And your boobs are like “BAM!”
lines.zh: : 而且你的胸就像「砰！」

lines.en: scene yumisits10
: Literally don’t get it at all.
lines.zh: : 我真的完全搞不懂。

lines.en: : It’s because of my weight...She just...seems to have a problem with that for some reason.
lines.zh: : 是因为我的体重……她……不知道为什么就是对这事有意见。

lines.en: : Well, that’s a stupid thing to take issue with. I think you’re adorable and I see you more than anyone, so that should mean something.
lines.zh: : 拿这个说事也太蠢了。我觉得你超可爱，而且我见你的次数比谁都多，这总该有点分量吧。

lines.en: scene yumisits11
: It does mean something. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 是很有分量。谢谢。

lines.en: : And for the record, I can’t imagine ever having any wingman other than you. So thanks for looking out for me all the time.
lines.zh: : 还有，说真的，我无法想象除了你以外还有谁能当我的搭档。谢谢你一直照顾我。

lines.en: : Dude, duh. Thanks for looking out for {i}me{/i} all the time. I’m the loopy one. You’re just getting picked on by some girl with...self-esteem issues or something.
lines.zh: : 姐妹，那当然。也谢谢你一直照顾{i}我{/i}。我才是那个疯疯癫癫的。你只是被某个……有自卑情结还是什么的女生找茬罢了。

lines.en: scene yumisits12
: Actually, now that I really think about it, what {i}is{/i} her deal anyway?
lines.zh: : 说真的，现在仔细想想，她到底{i}怎么回事{/i}啊？

lines.en: : I don’t know, like...{i}anything{/i} about Yumi. Which is weird because I know like six million things about Chika.
lines.zh: : Yumi的事我……{i}一无所知{/i}。这很奇怪，因为我光是Chika的事就知道大概六百万件。

lines.en: : Chika? I thought you didn’t know anyone named Chika?
lines.zh: : Chika？你不是说你不认识叫Chika的人吗？

lines.en: scene yumisits13
: Wait, did I say Chika?! I meant...Chicken! I know a lot of...facts about chickens!
lines.zh: : 等等，我说Chika了吗？！我是说……鸡！我知道很多……关于鸡的知识！

lines.en: : Name three...
lines.zh: : 说三条……

lines.en: : Feathers! Wings! Beaks!
lines.zh: : 羽毛！翅膀！喙！

lines.en: : Those are just parts of the chicken, Rin. They aren’t really facts...
lines.zh: : 那只是鸡的身体部位啊，Rin。算不上知识……

lines.en: : They are! Now let’s...go do the thing or whatever!
lines.zh: : 就是知识！好了，我们……去做那件事吧！

lines.en: scene yumisits14
: Hah...
: Guess there’s no harm in trying again...
lines.zh: : 再试一次也没什么损失吧……

lines.en: : Here goes nothing.
lines.zh: : 管它呢，豁出去了。

lines.en: scene black
scene yumisits15
Three girls in a line on the beach.
lines.zh: 三个女孩在海滩上排成一列。

lines.en: One calm. One callous. One concerned.
lines.zh: 一个平静。一个冷漠。一个关切。

lines.en: And despite the girls having zero chemistry when inserted into the petri dish we call society, they do their best to emulate conversation as if they’re lifelong friends.
lines.zh: 尽管把这三个女孩放进我们称之为社会的培养皿里，她们之间毫无化学反应，却还是尽力装作一生挚友般交谈。

lines.en: The only issue is that two of them {i}are{/i} while one has a hard time comprehending why she’s here in the first place.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，其中两人{i}是{/i}朋友，而剩下那个连自己为什么在这里都搞不太明白。

lines.en: But such is life.
lines.zh: 可人生就是这样。

lines.en: No one knows why they’re here.
lines.zh: 没人知道自己为什么在这里。

lines.en: There are those who {i}think{/i} they know.
lines.zh: 有人{i}自以为{/i}知道。

lines.en: But they, too, are just specimens in petri dishes waiting for someone to come along and identify their purpose.
lines.zh: 可他们也不过是培养皿里的标本，等着有人来鉴定他们的用途。

lines.en: Oh, how disgusting it is to watch them squirm beneath the microscope.
lines.zh: 看着他们在显微镜下扭动，真是令人作呕。

lines.en: : Yo! Mind if we join you?
lines.zh: : 哟！介意我们坐这边吗？

lines.en: : Uhh, yeah. Kind of.
lines.zh: : 呃，介意。挺介意的。

lines.en: : What do you want?
lines.zh: : 你们想干嘛？

lines.en: : Oh, nothing. Just wanted to sit by the water for a bit.
lines.zh: : 哦，没什么。就是想在海边坐会儿。

lines.en: scene yumisits16
: You know there’s water fuckin’ everywhere, right? We’re at the beach.
lines.zh: : 你知道这他妈到处都是水吧？我们在海滩上。

lines.en: : This isn’t the beach. This is a bathtub.
lines.zh: : 这不是海滩，这是浴缸。

lines.en: scene yumisits17
: Heh?
: Sorry. It’s a thing. I swear.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。这是个梗。我发誓。

lines.en: scene yumisits15
: You’re fucking weird.
lines.zh: : 你真他妈怪。

lines.en: : What’s the problem with that?
lines.zh: : 那有什么问题？

lines.en: : Being weird is fun. You should try it sometime.
lines.zh: : 古怪是件有趣的事。你哪天也该试试。

lines.en: : Pass.
lines.zh: : 免了。

lines.en: : Bad enough that I have to sit next to-
lines.zh: : 光是坐我旁边的就已经够糟了——

lines.en: scene yumisits18
: Oh! That reminds me!
lines.zh: : 哦！我想起来了！

lines.en: : I was wondering if maybe you’d want to come eat dinner with Futaba and me tonight?
lines.zh: : 我在想，你今晚要不要和二叶、我一起吃饭？

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 哈？为什么？

lines.en: : Well...you know! Food! It’s a good way to bond with people or whatever.
lines.zh: : 那个……你知道的！吃饭！这是和人拉近距离的好办法什么的。

lines.en: : We were in class together in middle[school], weren’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们初中[school]是同班吧？

lines.en: scene yumisits19
: Surprised you remember. I barely showed up back then either.
lines.zh: : 你居然还记得。那时候我本来也几乎不去上学。

lines.en: : Yeah...Hey, that’s when you and Chika started hanging out, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯……话说，你和Chika就是那时候开始混在一起的吧？

lines.en: : ...Oh, right. Forgot who I was talkin’ to for a sec.
lines.zh: : ……哦，对。我差点忘了自己在跟谁说话。

lines.en: : Listen, I don’t know where Chika is. You have her number, don’t you? Just fuckin’ text her.
lines.zh: : 听着，我不知道Chika在哪儿。你有她号码吧？直接他妈发短信给她啊。

lines.en: : No point invitin’ me to hang out just to get info on her.
lines.zh: : 没必要为了打听她的事来约我。

lines.en: scene yumisits20
: That’s-
lines.zh: : 那不是——

lines.en: : That’s not what Rin was trying to say...
lines.zh: : Rin不是那个意思……

lines.en: : Oh?
: Then what {i}was{/i} she trying to say, fatass? Enlighten me.
lines.zh: : 那她{i}是{/i}什么意思，死胖子？说来听听。

lines.en: scene yumisits22
: Hey! I don’t know what your deal is, but that’s my friend you’re talking-
lines.zh: : 喂！我不知道你有什么毛病，但那是我的朋友，你——

lines.en: : It’s fine, Rin. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 没事的，Rin。别管了。

lines.en: scene yumisits23
: Ugh...whatever.
lines.zh: : 啧……随你吧。

lines.en: : We just...saw you sitting here alone and thought maybe you might be a little happier if you were hanging out with people.
lines.zh: : 我们只是……看到你一个人坐在这儿，想着也许有人陪你会开心一点。

lines.en: : I know it’s hard to not have anyone you’re close to around and-
lines.zh: : 我知道身边没有亲近的人很难受，而且——

lines.en: scene yumisits23
: Oh, boo-fucking-hoo. It’s not like I’m sitting alone because I’m afraid of talking to anyone or some boring shit like that.
lines.zh: : 哦，呜呜呜哭个屁。我又不是因为不敢跟人说话之类的无聊理由才一个人坐着的。

lines.en: : I’m sitting alone because I like being alone. End of story.
lines.zh: : 我一个人坐是因为我喜欢一个人。就这么简单。

lines.en: : And now that you two showed up, my nice, quiet evening has been trashed and I’m going to go home pissed off.
lines.zh: : 现在你们俩一来，我美好安静的傍晚就被毁了，我得气呼呼地回家了。
: 我……明白了……

lines.en: scene yumisits24
: So fucking annoying. I have no idea how Chika puts up with bein’ nice to people all the time and shit.
lines.zh: : 烦死人了。我真不懂Chika怎么能一直对人和和气气的什么的。

lines.en: : All I want is for everybody to just stay out of my fucking business.
lines.zh: : 我只想让所有人都他妈别管我的事。

lines.en: : It’s bad enough having to fuckin’ fend off the god damn teacher all the time, but now I have to deal with you dipshits as well? Fucking Christ.
lines.zh: : 天天还得他妈防着那个死老师就已经够烦了，现在还得应付你们两个蠢货？操。

lines.en: scene yumisits26
: Why bring Sensei into this? He’s not even here right now.
lines.zh: : 干嘛扯上Sensei？他现在又不在这儿。

lines.en: : Bullshit. Dude’s always lurkin’ in the background somewhere. He’s probably behind a tree jerking off to us right now.
lines.zh: : 放屁。那家伙总是藏在什么地方。他现在说不定就躲在树后面对我们打飞机呢。

lines.en: : Sensei isn’t like that, Yumi...He really does care about us.
lines.zh: : Sensei不是那种人，Yumi……他是真的关心我们。

lines.en: scene yumisits27
: Care?! You think that fucking pervert {i}cares{/i} about us? Jesus, you’re even dumber than I thought!
lines.zh: : 关心？！你觉得那个死变态会{i}关心{/i}我们？天哪，你比我想的还蠢！

lines.en: : Just because he asks you to suck him off all the time doesn’t mean he fuckin' {i}cares{/i} about you! He’s using you!
lines.zh: : 他老让你给他口交，不代表他他妈{i}关心{/i}你！他只是在利用你！

lines.en: scene yumisits28
: Woah! Slow down! Who said anything about sucking anyone off?!
lines.zh: : 哇！慢着！谁说口交什么的了？！

lines.en: : Sensei is a good guy and wouldn’t ever force anyone to do anything they don’t want to!
lines.zh: : Sensei是好人，他绝不会强迫任何人做不想做的事！

lines.en: : Oh, if you only knew fucking half of it.
lines.zh: : 哦，你要是知道一半就好了。

lines.en: : And what’s with that shit about “not doing anything they don't want to do?” You think it makes it okay for a teacher to fuck his students as long as they’re okay with it?
lines.zh: : 还有那套「不做不想做的事」是什么意思？你觉得只要学生愿意，老师睡学生就没问题了？

lines.en: scene yumisits29
: Dude...
lines.zh: : 姐妹……

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 干嘛？

lines.en: : What {i}happened{/i} to you?
lines.zh: : {i}你怎么变成这样了{/i}？

lines.en: : The fuck are you talkin’ about?
lines.zh: : 你他妈在说什么？

lines.en: : I just don’t get how you can be so uptight all the time...We literally just came over here to ask if you wanted to eat with us.
lines.zh: : 我就是不懂你怎么能一直这么紧绷……我们真的只是过来问你要不要一起吃饭。

lines.en: : I’m not normally one to regret my decisions but...fuck, Yumi. You went and turned our nice gesture into a left field attack on our teacher.
lines.zh: : 我平时很少后悔自己的决定，可是……操，Yumi。你把我们的一番好意变成了对我们老师的无端攻击。

lines.en: : Hey, {i}you’re{/i} the ones who decided to come and talk to {i}me.{/i} Ain't my fault if you regret it.
lines.zh: : 嘿，是{i}你们{/i}自己决定过来跟{i}我{/i}说话的。你们后悔也怪不着我。

lines.en: : If you dislike it so much, why don’t the two of you fuck off and go eat or whatever instead of wasting your time inviting the class delinquent?
lines.zh: : 要是你们这么不爽，干嘛不滚去吃饭什么的，非要把时间浪费在邀请班上的不良少女上？

lines.en: : Oh, Hell no. We’re not going-
lines.zh: : 哦，绝对不行。我们才不——

lines.en: : Let’s go, Rin.
lines.zh: : 走吧，Rin。

lines.en: scene yumisits30
: What?...
: Really?...
lines.zh: : 真的吗？……

lines.en: : After all that you just want to leave?
lines.zh: : 闹成这样你还要走？

lines.en: : Yumi wants to be left alone, so we should leave her alone.
lines.zh: : Yumi想一个人待着，那我们就该让她一个人待着。

lines.en: : It’s not our place to force her into doing anything she doesn’t want to do.
lines.zh: : 我们没有资格逼她做不想做的事。

lines.en: : Wish everyone would fuckin’ think that.
lines.zh: : 真希望所有人都能他妈这么想。

lines.en: scene black
Miscommunications.
lines.zh: 误读。

lines.en: Misunderstandings.
lines.zh: 误解。

lines.en: The circumstances and situations we find ourselves in often lead to nothing but anguish at the end of the day.
lines.zh: 我们身处的境况，到头来往往只带来痛苦。

lines.en: Forming bonds sounds more like a pipe dream when factoring in how they would impact others if we could only peer through the looking glass.
lines.zh: 如果能透过窥镜预见羁绊会给他人带来什么影响，那结下羁绊听起来就更像是痴人说梦了。

lines.en: Three girls in a line on the beach.
lines.zh: 三个女孩在海滩上排成一列。

lines.en: Each involved in a different relationship with the same man.
lines.zh: 各自和同一个男人维系着不同的关系。

lines.en: Each with a different view of him.
lines.zh: 各自对他有着不同的看法。

lines.en: How is it possible for three people to be so closely linked and yet so far apart?
lines.zh: 三个人怎么能联系如此紧密，却又相隔如此遥远？

lines.en: Such is the petri dish.
lines.zh: 培养皿便是如此。

lines.en: And such is life.
lines.zh: 人生也是如此。

lines.en: Perhaps we are not all meant to be happy.
lines.zh: 也许我们并非生来就该幸福。

lines.en: And perhaps the girl in the middle of the line is meant to destroy herself in pursuit of what makes the other two whole.
lines.zh: 也许排在中间的那个女孩，注定要在追寻让另外两人完整之物的过程中毁掉自己。

lines.en: {i}Praise be!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}赞美吧！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Not one god, but three!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不是一位神，而是三位！{/i}

lines.en: {i}The further we fall, the more we will see!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我们跌落得越深，看到的就越多！{/i}

lines.en: {i}HOPE is the answer, but won’t be the key!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}HOPE 就是答案，却不会是钥匙！{/i}

lines.en: $ beachvacation6 = True
$ trinity = True
The day drags on.
lines.zh: 这一天就这样慢慢过去。

scene theend
